title: Healing in His Wings
old_p1: Malachi said the “Sun of righteousness” would rise. Righteousness means being good and doing what is right.
This Sun is Jesus. Like the morning sun, Jesus brings light and warmth to the whole world.
He would rise “with healing in his wings.” Healing means making better. The sun’s warm rays spread out wide, like wings.
old_p2: Malachi said the people would “grow up as calves of the stall.” A stall is a little room in a barn, where calves stay warm and fed. When calves are let out, they run and jump in the sunshine!
Jesus helps us feel better and glad inside. Tonight, wiggle your toes like a happy calf, then lie still in His warm love.
p1: Malachi had a happy promise for the people who loved the Lord.
The “Sun of righteousness” would rise, the One who is always good and right. Malachi was talking about Jesus.
Like the morning sun, Jesus brings light and warmth to the whole world. He would come “with healing in his wings,” like warm sunbeams spreading wide.
p2: Then the people would “grow up as calves of the stall.” Baby cows wait inside a barn stall. When they are let out, they run and jump in the sunshine!
Jesus helps us feel better and glad inside. Tonight, wiggle your toes like a happy calf. Then rest in His warm love.
